# Changelog

The research snapshot is an editorial date stored in `content/metadata.json`, not an automatic build stamp. HTTP audit timestamps are actual request times and may differ from this date.

## 1.3.0 — 21 October 2026

Beginner-language review revision:

- Rewrote all 93 introductions around a concrete explanation, a use and one brief caveat. Grouped topics use labelled mini-sentences, and each RL axis guide explains learning from rewards.
- Added six canonical glossary entries, shown at the top of First steps and available beside each plain-language heading in the app and standalone tree.
- Inserted self-supervised learning between neural networks and language models. First steps now has 13 topics, with stable topic IDs, journey route and browser-local progress.
- Enforced a maximum of 18 words per sentence and no semicolons. Added estimated readability warnings and a reproducible before/after report. Meaningful caveats and readability still need editorial review.
- Adjusted proposed analogies where they could misstate transformer access, Gaussian-process smoothness, physical-rule enforcement or conformal coverage.
- Preserved technical guides, research references, history and HTTP-audit timestamps. The maintainer credit remains an individual attribution without an institutional endorsement claim.
- Reader-comprehension testing outside the field remains pending.

## 1.2.0 — 21 October 2026

Plain-language integration:

- Added an “In plain words” introduction with a specific caveat to all 93 guides. The technical description now begins “The idea,” after the introduction.
- Reused the canonical text in the standalone tree figure, search results, journey steps and saved cards. Search includes everyday wording; full paragraphs remain visible without clipping their caveats.
- Renamed and expanded the existing `foundations` journey to “First steps: understanding AI,” progressing through 12 topics from rules and search to language systems, agents, uncertainty, security and evaluation. The journey route and browser-local read/bookmark format remain stable; progress uses the revised topic list.
- Added presence, length, placeholder and duplicate-copy checks and exact app/figure data consistency checks. Included the additional text in reading-time estimates.
- Preserved the research snapshot, references and recorded HTTP-audit timestamps. This wording release is not a fresh link audit.
- Plain-language drafting and review were AI-assisted. Comprehension testing with readers outside the field remains pending; no independent reader validation is claimed.

## 1.1.0 — 21 October 2026

External-review revision of the first edition:

- Replaced the universal `verified` date with a reproducible HEAD/GET checker and per-URL evidence. Availability results are displayed separately from source-content review.
- Added foundational references across language modeling, score/diffusion models, hierarchical RL, world models, search, statistical methods, neural architectures, retrieval and interpretability.
- Added CoT, Tree of Thoughts, confidence/abstention, SHAP and mechanistic-interpretability context. Added paper records for AlphaGeometry, AlphaEvolve and Nested Learning; retained Genie 3 as documentation.
- Added eight guides: anomaly detection; state estimation; optimal/MPC control; adversarial robustness and security; evaluation and leakage; fairness and data governance; equation discovery; scaling laws.
- Added an industrial monitoring journey and useful cross-links. Directed recommendations remain directed when appropriate.
- Replaced the backpropagation-to-Mamba edge with S4-to-Mamba. Added explicit S4, flow-matching and 2026 diffusion-LM study milestones; separated nonoverlapping period bands and the undated horizon.
- Corrected diffusion-LM wording and reference titles; updated the BoTorch overview URL and used the CBR DOI.
- Added maintainer, AI-assisted production, licence-status and review notes. Self-hosted both font families with their OFL notices.
- Regenerate both figures from shared JSON and explicit templates; removed literal date/snippet patching and duplicated topic data.

## 1.0.0 — 21 October 2026

Initial research edition: 85 guides, five facets, 27 milestones, four journeys and six frontier summaries. Included interactive figures, topic search, bookmarks, browser-local progress and the downloadable source project. Its per-reference `verified` date was an editorial annotation, not machine-produced evidence; version 1.1.0 removes that ambiguity.
